name: Shanghai SK Automation Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai SK Automation Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of intelligent manufacturing equipment in China and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Equipment Systems and Precision Structural Components. It offers battery module and pack production, cell factory logistics conveyor, auto chassis production, and motor electric control production lines, as well as non-standard custom equipment; conveying technology; and testing technology, industrial manufacturing data, and simulation and virtual reality.
